d: Mokama ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi aagami 25 navanbar ko hone ja rahi hai. ek taraph jahan anant sinh ke paitrik ganv ladma men is shahi shadi samaroh ko lekar bhavy aayojan ki taiyariyan chal rahi hain, vahin dusri taraph bihta sthit anant sinh ke samdhi ke ghar behad sadgi ke sath taiyariyan ki ja rahi hain.
